paper: Towards Universal Fake Image Detectors that Generalize Across Generative Models (UnivFD / UniversalFakeDetect). Ojha, Li, Lee — CVPR 2023.
training_set_in_paper: ProGAN real-vs-fake from Wang et al. CNNDetection (the 20-class 'wang2020' set): 20 LSUN object categories, 360k real + 360k ProGAN fake = 720k images (18k fake/category). CLIP:ViT-L/14 backbone FROZEN; only a linear fc is trained (--fix_backbone). README L74-94; train cmd L92. The NN variant uses no trained head (k-NN in frozen CLIP feature space).

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths GAN/low-level test (11 of the paper's 19 models; from Wang et al.)
benchmarks.metric: AP (Table 2) and acc@0.5 (Table 3); paper also reports best-threshold acc

paper_number.note: The paper does NOT report a single 'ForenSynths-N mAP' cell. It reports per-generator AP (Table 2) and per-generator acc (Table 3) for the LC (linear-classifier) and NN (k=1) variants. GAN-family AP subtotal for the LC variant ≈ 99.31 (ar5iv). 19-model totals (per README + PDF-derived spec): AP_LC 93.38 / acc_LC 81.38; AP_NN 90.32 / acc_NN 82.30. There is no clean paper '~98' headline mAP — that loose figure is the GAN-only LC subtotal.

paper_per_generator.note: These per-generator AP_LC values are from the prior PDF-derived spec; the GAN subset {ProGAN,CycleGAN,BigGAN,StyleGAN,GauGAN,StarGAN,DeepFake} dominates the headline.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: validate.py RealFakeDataset.transform (L198-202): transforms.CenterCrop(224) ONLY — NO Resize — then ToTensor + Normalize with CLIP mean/std (MEAN['clip']/STD['clip'], L31-39). Model = CLIP:ViT-L/14 frozen, only model.fc loaded from fc_weights.pth (L278-280). set_seed(0) per domain (L23-28, L293). AP via sklearn average_precision_score; acc@0.5 + best-threshold acc (validate L97-128). dataset_paths.py lists the 13 ForenSynths dirs (progan..imle) wang2020 mode (must_contain 0_real/1_fake, L207-209).

our_number.note: SynthScope ForenSynths-8 mAP 97.22 (official-weights-in-SynthScope 96.95); ForenSynths-13 92.99 (official 93.14). SynthScope-trained head matches the official fc_weights.pth.

benchmarks.gap_cause: n/a — reproduced. SynthScope 92.99 (FS-13) ≈ official 93.14 ≈ paper AP_LC 19-model total 93.38. SynthScope transform tf_resize_crop(256,224,CLIP_MEAN,CLIP_STD) (registry.py:150) adds a Resize(256) the official lacks (CenterCrop(224) only); the tiny FS-13 difference (92.99 vs 93.14) is consistent with that resize plus the SynthScope-trained vs official head, well within match tolerance.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/CNNDetection/test (all 13 dirs incl. the 11 paper subsets). Origin: ForenSynths test ~19GB, gdrive 1z_fD3UKgWQyOTZIBbYSaQ-hz4AzUrLC1.

benchmarks.name: UniversalFakeDetect diffusion/autoregressive test (the other 8 of the 19 models)

paper_number.note: Headline: on unseen diffusion+AR models the LC mean AP ≈ 95.0 (+19.49 over the 75.51 SoTA baseline per ar5iv); the NN variant mean AP ≈ 90.58 (+15.07). The widely cited claim is '+15.07 mAP / +25.90% acc over prior SoTA' (NN). Paper reports diffusion AP over 10k sampled images/domain; the public release ships only 1k/1k per domain.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same CenterCrop(224)+CLIP-norm transform; reals = imagenet (for guided) / laion (for ldm/glide/dalle); dataset_paths.py L90-149. max_sample default 1000 (validate L259); paper used 10k.

our_number.note: SynthScope UFD-8 mAP 96.44, official-weights 95.66, both ≈ paper LC diffusion AP ~95.

benchmarks.gap_cause: n/a — reproduced (SynthScope 96.44 ≥ official 95.66 ≈ paper ~95). Evaluated on the public 1k/domain release, not the paper's 10k sampling, so a small drift from the exact paper cells is expected.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/universialfakedetection/test (1k-release: 8 fake subsets + imagenet/laion reals). Full: gdrive 1FXlGIRh_Ud3cScMgSVDbEWmPDmjcrm1t (only 1k/domain is publicly released).

summary: UnivFD reports per-generator AP (Table 2) + acc (Table 3) over 19 models split into a ForenSynths GAN/low-level group (11) and a diffusion/AR group (8), for LC and NN variants — i.e. 2 benchmark groups (no single headline mAP cell). We reproduce BOTH: ForenSynths SynthScope 92.99 (FS-13) / 97.22 (FS-8) ≈ official 93.14/96.95 ≈ paper AP_LC total 93.38; diffusion SynthScope 96.44 ≈ official 95.66 ≈ paper LC ~95. Nothing missing or below. CLIP is reproduced via an SynthScope-trained linear head (ckpt_kind=synthscope) that matches the official fc_weights.pth. Caveat: diffusion eval uses the public 1k/domain release vs the paper's 10k sampling. Note: SynthScope's eval transform adds a Resize(256) before CenterCrop(224) that the official CenterCrop-only protocol omits — negligible effect at match level.
